# pbs_remote (Resource)

Manages a PBS remote server configuration.

Remote configurations allow PBS to connect to other PBS servers for pulling or pushing backups. 
Remotes are referenced by sync jobs to replicate data between PBS instances.

**Note:** The password is stored in Terraform state, but is write-only from the API perspective (the API does not return the password on GET requests). 
Updates to the password will always be sent to the API but cannot be verified by reading back the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example PBS remote configuration with API token authentication
resource "pbs_remote" "backup_server" {
  name     = "backup-pbs"
  host     = "backup.example.com"
  port     = 8007
  auth_id  = "sync@pbs!backup-token"
  password = var.backup_token_secret # API token secret
  
  # Optional: X509 certificate fingerprint for TLS verification
  fingerprint = "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99"
  
  # Optional: Description
  comment = "Backup PBS server for sync jobs"
}

# Example PBS remote with password authentication
resource "pbs_remote" "offsite_pbs" {
  name     = "offsite"
  host     = "192.168.1.100"
  auth_id  = "admin@pam"
  password = var.offsite_password  # Recommended: use variable for sensitive data
  
  comment = "Offsite PBS for disaster recovery"
}

# Example without port (defaults to 8007)
resource "pbs_remote" "local_pbs" {
  name     = "local-backup"
  host     = "pbs.local"
  auth_id  = "sync@pbs!sync-token"
  password = var.sync_password
}

variable "backup_token_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "offsite_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "sync_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_id` (String) Authentication ID for the remote server (e.g., `user@pam` or `user@pbs!token`).
- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the remote PBS server.
- `name` (String) The unique identifier for the remote (3-32 characters).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password or authentication token for the remote server. This value is write-only from the API perspective (not returned on GET), but will be stored in Terraform state as a sensitive value.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this remote.
- `fingerprint` (String) X509 certificate fingerprint (SHA256) for TLS verification. Format: `AA:BB:CC:...` (32 pairs of hex digits separated by colons).
- `port` (Number) The port number for the remote PBS server (default: 8007).

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file (remote.cfg) as of the last read. Informational only: it covers all objects in that file, changes on every write and is not used for locking.
